name: Initial claims stress
definition: 100 × (4-week average ICSA / trailing 52-week minimum of that 4-week average − 1)
lag_and_revision: typically days after week end; seasonal revisions; historical study has no vintage panel
decision_informed: Check whether employment deterioration is broad-based; request human regime review, no trade instruction
kill_criterion: Suspend predictive wording unless prospective mature episode hit rate exceeds same-calendar null after 20 independent episodes; retire duplicate review alert if no distinct human decision in 8 quarterly audits
free_machine_readable: Yes, public FRED CSV; collection environment may require browser same-origin capture

name: Sahm unemployment rule
definition: SAHMREALTIME: 3-month mean unemployment minus minimum of 3-month means over preceding 12 months
lag_and_revision: monthly observation known in following month; source expressly reconstructs information available then
decision_informed: Check recession-state evidence and labour composition; explicitly mark usually coincident/late
kill_criterion: Retire future-onset predictive role now; diagnostic role reviewed if false alarms dominate first 10 prospectively archived independent episodes
free_machine_readable: Yes, public FRED CSV; collection environment may require browser same-origin capture

name: Monthly yield-curve inversion
definition: GS10 − TB3MS; monthly averages, one-month study availability lag
lag_and_revision: one-month conservative study lag; observed daily curves are a different definition
decision_informed: Schedule 24-month scenario follow-up; no timing or allocation signal
kill_criterion: Remove recession-forecast label if prospective 20 independent episodes fail to exceed same-calendar event baseline; retain rate context
free_machine_readable: Yes, public FRED CSV; collection environment may require browser same-origin capture

name: Baa Treasury spread level
definition: Last BAA10Y observation per completed month
lag_and_revision: market days; last-month observation date retained; source corrections possible
decision_informed: Describe current credit conditions; historical future-event specificity is poor
kill_criterion: Demote to context if no incremental review information beyond spread change over 8 quarterly audits
free_machine_readable: Yes, public FRED CSV; collection environment may require browser same-origin capture

name: Baa spread acceleration
definition: Month-last BAA10Y minus month-last BAA10Y three calendar months earlier
lag_and_revision: market days; native source corrections possible; monthly signal archive
decision_informed: Review credit deterioration and data consistency; sample has only 2 mature onsets, so no predictive probability claim
kill_criterion: Do not grant predictive status before substantially more independent episodes; retire duplicate alert if no distinct human review decision in 8 quarterly audits
free_machine_readable: Yes, public FRED CSV; collection environment may require browser same-origin capture

name: National financial conditions
definition: Last NFCI observation in completed month; study availability lag one month
lag_and_revision: conservative one-month study lag; history revises as components/standardization change
threshold_choice: Published index mean boundary, not fitted
decision_informed: Cross-check whether tightening extends beyond corporate credit; do not count correlated measures as independent votes
kill_criterion: Demote if no incremental informational value beyond claims and Baa for 8 quarterly audits
free_machine_readable: Yes, public FRED CSV; collection environment may require browser same-origin capture

name: CPI inflation level
lag_and_revision: typically following month; seasonal revisions; missing periods stay missing
history: 1947-01 raw; study derived after 1954 sample start
threshold_choice: Round context boundary, not central-bank target
decision_informed: Identify purchasing-power regime and require inflation scenario update; no equity crash forecast
kill_criterion: Retire predictive use now; retain descriptive level unless source quality fails
free_machine_readable: Yes, public FRED CSV; collection environment may require browser same-origin capture

name: CPI inflation acceleration
definition: Calendar CPI YoY >=4% AND YoY − YoY 12 calendar months earlier >=2 percentage points
lag_and_revision: following-month availability; revised history; exact calendar missingness
decision_informed: Distinguish persistent level from accelerating inflation; update inflation scenario once per episode
kill_criterion: Retire separate card if it adds no interpretation beyond CPI level in 8 quarterly audits
free_machine_readable: Yes, public FRED CSV; collection environment may require browser same-origin capture
